note: Seed demos plus verified public fails appended 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-03. demo=false = sourced.

fails.titleZh: 风控未标高风险，自动履约亏光货款
fails.titleEn: Fraud unmarked + auto-fulfill → $3K loss
fails.failZh: 开启自动处理且依赖「高风险不处理」；同一地址、不同姓名邮箱连下同款 10 件，Shopify 全标正常。代发已履约后遭拒付全败，欠平台约 $3,013。
fails.failEn: Auto-process with “skip high-risk” on; flood of 10× same SKU to one Miami address under different names/emails—all marked fine. Dropship fulfilled; every chargeback lost; owed ~$3,013.
fails.fixZh: 关掉自动履约；对同址多单/重复 SKU 人工审核；叠加 3DS 与第三方风控，勿只信平台欺诈分。
fails.fixEn: Disable auto-fulfill; manually hold same-address / repeat-SKU bursts; add 3DS + a fraud tool beyond Shopify’s score alone.

fails.titleZh: 新店应买家取消一单，触发 10% 滚动保证金
fails.titleEn: One customer cancel → 10% reserve for 120 days
fails.failZh: 开店约 30 天、0 拒付、约 115 单；应买家请求取消未发货订单后 24h 内打款被冻。补齐发票与库存照后仍被加 10% 保证金 120 天，Q4 预估锁约 $50k。
fails.failEn: 30-day store, 0 chargebacks, ~115 orders; refunded one unfulfilled cancel at buyer request. Within 24h payouts held; after docs, 10% reserve for 120 days (~$50k locked through Q4).
fails.fixZh: 新主体备足现金流与备用收款通道；保留供应商发票/库存照；高风险标单勿轻易履约。
fails.fixEn: Keep cash buffer + backup gateway for new entities; archive supplier invoices/inventory photos; don’t fulfill high-risk-flagged orders lightly.

fails.titleZh: Developer Preview 误导「可保留 2 年」致店铺不可恢复
fails.titleEn: Dev Preview UI said 2-year restore—store gone
fails.failZh: Partner Developer Preview 建好准上线店后取消；后台写「信息保留 2 年可联系恢复」。多轮客服后承认文案错误且 Preview 店无法恢复，资产与 $500+ 成本归零。
fails.failEn: Built a production-ready Partner Developer Preview store, then cancelled. Admin said data kept 2 years for reactivation; after days of support, admitted the UI was wrong—Preview stores unrestorable; $500+ assets lost.
fails.fixZh: Preview 当易失环境；关键主题/素材/目录独立备份导出；切付费计划前先导出，勿信后台保留承诺。
fails.fixEn: Treat Preview as volatile; back up themes/assets/catalogs off-platform; export before plan switches—don’t trust the 2-year UI copy.

fails.titleZh: 迁站后旧 Shopify 链接全是 404
fails.titleEn: Legacy Shopify URLs still 404 after migration
fails.failZh: 旧 Shopify/Etsy 链接在广告与社媒仍被点击，155 条路径进 404；GA 显示 0 购买，实际 Stripe 有约 $249 成单，广告在优化空信号。
fails.failEn: Old Shopify/Etsy links still drew clicks—155 paths hit 404. GA showed 0 purchases while Stripe logged a ~$249 order; ads optimized on empty signals.
fails.fixZh: 做完整 301 重定向图并保留路径转发；核对购买事件与支付后台一致后再放大广告。
fails.fixEn: Ship a full 301 redirect map (preserve path at the registrar); reconcile purchase events vs the payment dashboard before scaling ads.

fails.titleZh: Script Tag 冻结后重装 App 静默丢追踪
fails.titleEn: Script Tag freeze: reinstall silently kills tracking
fails.failZh: 2026-10-01 起无法新建/更新 Script Tag；重装仍靠 Script Tag 的 App 后像素不回写，店面看似正常，广告侧转化归零。
fails.failEn: Since 2026-10-01 Shopify blocks creating/updating Script Tags. Reinstalling a script-tag app looks fine but events never return—tracking dies silently.
fails.fixZh: 审计 scriptTags；迁到 Web Pixels / Theme App Embed；大促前勿重装未迁移的追踪 App。
fails.fixEn: Audit scriptTags; migrate to Web Pixels / theme app embeds; do not reinstall unmigrated tracking apps before peak sales.

fails.titleZh: 加购 App 被注入脚本劫持结账跳转
fails.titleEn: Upsell app script injected → checkout redirect
fails.failZh: 2026-10-13 Selleasy 遭外部攻击，恶意脚本注入店面，部分买家结账被重定向到外部站。
fails.failEn: On 2026-10-13 Selleasy was attacked; a malicious script redirected some shoppers away at checkout.
fails.fixZh: 异常跳转立刻关闭 App Embed；核查结账仍在自有域名；优先选用可快速关停注入的 App，并跟进官方清理通知。
fails.fixEn: Disable the app embed on odd redirects; verify checkout stays on your domain; prefer apps whose inject path can be killed fast; follow vendor cleanup notices.

fails.titleZh: 强制注册导致结账跳出
fails.titleEn: Forced account creation kills checkout
fails.failZh: 结账必须先注册，移动端跳出率飙升。
fails.failEn: Checkout required signup first; mobile bounce spiked.
fails.fixZh: 开启访客结账；注册放到下单后。
fails.fixEn: Enable guest checkout; defer signup until after purchase.

fails.titleZh: 运费在最后一步才显示
fails.titleEn: Shipping cost revealed too late
fails.failZh: 商品页写 Free shipping，结账突然加 $12。
fails.failEn: PDP said free shipping; checkout added $12.
fails.fixZh: 在购物车/商品页预估运费；门槛写清楚。
fails.fixEn: Show shipping estimator on cart/PDP; clarify thresholds.

fails.titleZh: Pixel 双重触发导致优化跑偏
fails.titleEn: Duplicate Pixel events skew optimization
fails.failZh: 主题 + App 各打一次 Purchase，ROAS 虚高后突然掉。
fails.failEn: Theme + app both fired Purchase; ROAS looked great then crashed.
fails.fixZh: 只留一条标准事件链路；用 Pixel Helper 验一次。
fails.fixEn: Keep one event path; verify with Pixel Helper.

fails.titleZh: Broad 投放但素材只有一张主图
fails.titleEn: Broad targeting with a single static creative
fails.failZh: 学习期烧完预算，CTR < 0.6%。
fails.failEn: Learning budget burned; CTR under 0.6%.
fails.fixZh: 先做 3–5 条短视频/UGC 测款，再放大。
fails.fixEn: Test 3–5 short video/UGC creatives before scaling.

fails.titleZh: 运费区与物流商覆盖不一致
fails.titleEn: Shipping zones don't match carrier coverage
fails.failZh: 阿拉斯加/夏威夷下单成功，实际无法发货。
fails.failEn: AK/HI orders accepted but not shippable.
fails.fixZh: 按承运商可达区配置 zone；不可达州禁用。
fails.fixEn: Align zones with carrier reach; block unreachable regions.

fails.titleZh: 跨境小包缺 HS Code 被扣关
fails.titleEn: Missing HS codes cause customs holds
fails.failZh: 商业发票品名写 gift，多次查验延误。
fails.failEn: Invoices said “gift”; repeated customs delays.
fails.fixZh: SKU 维护英文品名 + HS；禁写 gift/sample。
fails.fixEn: Maintain EN description + HS per SKU; never gift/sample.

fails.titleZh: 新店 PayPal 大额被冻结
fails.titleEn: New-store PayPal holds on large orders
fails.failZh: 首周大单后余额限制，发货资金断裂。
fails.failEn: Early large order triggered hold; cash for fulfillment froze.
fails.fixZh: 提升店铺信息完整度；大单先用卡支付分流；备第二收款通道。
fails.fixEn: Complete business profile; route big orders to cards; add backup payout.

fails.titleZh: 多币种显示与结算币种混乱
fails.titleEn: Display currency vs settlement mismatch
fails.failZh: 前台 EUR，后台仍 USD 结算，对账痛苦。
fails.failEn: Storefront EUR but settlement USD; reconciliation hell.
fails.fixZh: 明确 presentment vs settlement；报表按结算币汇总。
fails.fixEn: Clarify presentment vs settlement; report in settlement FX.

fails.titleZh: 装了 20+ App 首页 5 秒+
fails.titleEn: 20+ apps make homepage 5s+
fails.failZh: 弹窗、评价、像素、推荐全开，LCP 崩。
fails.failEn: Popups, reviews, pixels, upsells — LCP collapsed.
fails.fixZh: 审计 App；非关键延迟加载；合并像素。
fails.fixEn: Audit apps; defer non-critical; consolidate pixels.

fails.titleZh: App 改 Liquid 导致升级翻车
fails.titleEn: App Liquid edits break theme upgrade
fails.failZh: 一键升级主题后加购按钮消失。
fails.failEn: Theme upgrade removed ATC button.
fails.fixZh: 改动走 Theme App Extension；升级前预览副本。
fails.fixEn: Prefer Theme App Extensions; preview a copy before upgrade.

fails.titleZh: SEA COD 拒收率未计入 ROI
fails.titleEn: SEA COD rejection ignored in ROI
fails.failZh: 广告按 COD 下单量优化，实际签收仅 55%。
fails.failEn: Ads optimized on COD orders; delivery success only 55%.
fails.fixZh: 用签收/回款做核心指标；高风险地区预付优先。
fails.fixEn: Optimize on delivered/paid; prefer prepaid in high-risk areas.

fails.titleZh: 落地页跳转丢掉 UTM
fails.titleEn: Landing redirect strips UTMs
fails.failZh: 短链/应用跳转后 GA4 全变 direct。
fails.failEn: After short-link redirects, GA4 showed all direct.
fails.fixZh: 保留 query；用服务器或主题确保 UTM 透传。
fails.fixEn: Preserve query strings; ensure UTM passthrough in theme/server.

fails.titleZh: 退货政策与实际尾程冲突
fails.titleEn: Return policy clashes with last-mile reality
fails.failZh: 承诺 30 天免费退，跨境退件成本高于客单。
fails.failEn: Promised free 30-day returns; reverse logistics > AOV.
fails.fixZh: 跨境写清买家承担退运或本地退货仓。
fails.fixEn: State buyer-paid returns or local return hub for cross-border.

fails.titleZh: 未开 3DS 欧洲拒付飙升
fails.titleEn: No 3DS → EU chargeback spike
fails.failZh: PSD2 相关争议增多，利润被吞。
fails.failEn: PSD2-related disputes rose; margin eaten.
fails.fixZh: 对欧区开启 3DS/SCA；高风险交易加强验证。
fails.fixEn: Enable 3DS/SCA for EU; step-up high-risk txs.

fails.titleZh: 试用 App 到期自动扣费
fails.titleEn: Trial apps auto-charge unnoticed
fails.failZh: 月底账单多出 $200+ 无感知订阅。
fails.failEn: Month-end bill +$200 from forgotten trials.
fails.fixZh: 日历提醒试用结束；不用即卸；季度清一次账单。
fails.fixEn: Calendar trial ends; uninstall unused; quarterly bill audit.
